name: implosion_trigger_ring
description: A square ring of 8 DLAY timers at slightly different temperatures around a central PLUT pit + TTAN tamper -- reproduces an implosion lens's staggered-detonation timing (each charge fires at a different offset so the compression wave arrives at the pit simultaneously) as a reusable 'coordinated wave trigger' pattern, independent of the weapons context it was found in.
why: 2223794 ('Implosion type nuclear bomb') places 11 DLAY cells radially around (300,190) at deliberately different temperatures (since a DLAY's own temperature sets its firing delay): sampled values 122C, 180C, 198C, 218C, 242C, 258C, 284C, 302C, 320C, 336C. This is the most mechanically faithful weapon-physics reproduction in the whole harvest and the technique (staggered timers around a center) generalizes to any build that needs several triggers to fire in a coordinated wave rather than all at once. No existing module does staggered radial timing; DLAY-based sequencing elsewhere in the registry (deut_cell_mk2, injector_pod) is single-shot.
source: save 2223794, DLAY ring x248-368 y134-245 around center ~(300,190); PLUT pit and TTAN tamper per the save's description ('explosive charges implode the Plutonium core')
